Screen Goated Toolbox reduced ONNX Runtime for Android

This optional binary is built from ONNX Runtime v1.24.2 at commit
058787ceead760166e3c50a0a4cba8a833a6f53f. The source repository is:

  https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

The build is limited to the CPU operators required by the supported Moonshine
streaming models and the models embedded in the Moonshine runtime. It retains
the public ONNX Runtime C API used by Moonshine and is delivered independently
from the self-contained Sherpa runtime.

ONNX Runtime is distributed under the MIT License. See
onnxruntime-LICENSE.txt. Its complete upstream third-party attribution file is
included as onnxruntime-ThirdPartyNotices.txt.
